name: gamechat-monorepo
description: gamechat —— 壳无关的角色聊天框架：业务核心、壳适配器与扩展包。

scripts.lint: eslint packages/core packages/electron packages/schema packages/type apps/wuwachat
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run dist --workspace @gamechat/wuwachat
scripts.version:patch: echo '📦 升级补丁版本 (x.y.Z → x.y.Z+1)' && npm version patch --no-git-tag-version --workspace @gamechat/wuwachat
scripts.version:minor: echo '📦 升级次版本 (x.Y.z → x.Y+1.z)' && npm version minor --no-git-tag-version --workspace @gamechat/wuwachat
scripts.version:major: echo '📦 升级主版本 (x.Y.z → X+1.Y.z)' && npm version major --no-git-tag-version --workspace @gamechat/wuwachat
